sloka: स चापि रामः प्रतिपूर्णमानसो ।महद्धनम् धर्मबलैरुपार्जितम् ।नियोजयामास सुहृज्जनेऽचिरा ।द्यथार्हसम्मानवचःप्रचोदितः ॥२-३२-४३॥
transliteration: sa cāpi rāmaḥ pratipūrṇamānaso ।mahaddhanam dharmabalairupārjitam ।niyojayāmāsa suhṛjjane'cirā ।dyathārhasammānavacaḥpracoditaḥ ॥2-32-43॥

translations.english: Thereafter that great sage Trijata along with his wife, immensely happy to receive multitudes of cows, pronounced blessings on the magnanimous Rama for glory, power, pleasure and prosperity.
